title: Tuition payment reminder
description: Remind students or parents about an upcoming tuition payment. Payment reminder WhatsApp template for schools. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Use the amount, due date and invoice reference. Be courteous and avoid late-fee threats in the first reminder.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, a friendly reminder that your tuition installment of {{amount}} for *{{course}}* is due on {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
